evals.prompt: Use my supplied event-poster image as the template. Keep the background, typography style, layout and colors, but replace the event title, date, venue and QR code with the details I provide.
evals.expected_output: New poster with original preserved, requested design cues matched, all obsolete source details removed, new QR target verified, and side-by-side visual QA.
assertions: Background and key layout cues are retained
Old baked-in text is removed without visible ghosting
New factual content is not invented
Output is compared side-by-side with the reference

evals.prompt: Make a premium science symposium poster for researchers, portrait print size, with the real date and venue from my notes and a restrained scientific illustration.
evals.expected_output: Purposeful original direction, legible hierarchy, exact supplied facts, licensed or generated illustration, print dimensions and bleed checked against available specifications.
assertions: Design uses meaningful whitespace and coherent type/palette
